newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Mother of Malaysia's late Proton chief dies.
newsitem.headline: Mother of Malaysia's late Proton chief dies.

text.p: The 77-year-old mother of the late Malaysian industrialist Yahaya Ahmad died on Thursday, the director of Kuala Terengganu state hospital said.

Mandak Omar died three days after her 50-year-old son Yahaya perished in a helicopter crash on Monday night, along with his wife and pilot. Yahaya had been on his way to visit his mother, who was sick.
"She died this morning at 11 a.m. (0300 GMT)," hospital director Abdul Rashid Che Ali told Reuters on Thursday.
He declined to give the cause of her death. Local newspaper reports said Mandak had been recently hospitalised for a stroke.

Yahaya, chairman of national car maker Perusahaan Otomobil Nasional Bhd (Proton), was en route from the capital city Kuala Lumpur to Kuala Terengganu in eastern Terengganu state to visit Mandak in hospital when the helicopter went down in Pahang state.

The cause of the accident is still being probed, but the head of the Department of Civil Aviation was quoted in the New Straits Times newspaper on Thursday as saying he believed the Agusta 109 helicopter lost altitude when its blades came off.
